comment: Gentle bend (about 5 deg) where the trace crosses the timing line at v 1798 to 1802. Separate straight fits of the centerline above (v 1700 to 1794, slope 0.23 px/px, sd 0.37 px) and below (v 1806 to 1940, slope 0.135) meet at about (807,1808) for every fit window tried. P (806,1812) is about 4 px from that corner; Q (809,1793) is about 15 px above it, on the straight upper segment (the upper fit stays straight through v 1796). Medium because the bend is shallow and the timing line hides v 1798 to 1802.

Q (866,3031) sits where the trace (ink u 862 to 870) crosses the timing line at v 3028 to 3033; trace ink runs continuously above and below the timing line, so there is trace ink under the sample. It is not on the dashed line (u 855 to 858). The trace runs on down to the break symbol near v 3135.

All three Q samples are on the trace ink, which runs at u 856 to 866 here, separate from the dashed line at u 850 to 854. (860,2631): trace ink u 856 to 863 (the ruler tick is at u 835 to 840). (860,2661): trace ink u 856 to 864. (862,2722): on the timing line, but trace ink u 858 to 866 runs through it on both sides. None is in the trace's break around the '0' label (v 2683 to 2707).

P (838,1317) is at the center of the top frame line (solid v 1314 to 1319, ragged edge to 1321). The trace (u 835 to 842) can be told from the frame only down to about v 1320 to 1322, so its last visible ink is about 3 to 5 px from the sample, more than the 2 px allowed. Off (inside the frame).

Two corners at the onset. The main corner, where the steep rise leaves along the top of the 10 ms timing line, is at about (1320,2563); P (1320,2566) is within 3 px of it. Below it the trace's free (right) edge runs a short straight ramp from 1332 at v 2591 to 1324 at v 2570 (slope about 0.33 px/px), and a gentler bend where the trace leaves its vertical baseline (center u about 1329) is at about (1329,2595). Q (1325,2582) is on that straight ramp, about 14 px from the departure bend and about 19 px from the main corner, so it is at neither corner. If the project defines the onset as the first departure from the baseline instead, the point would be (1329,2595), which is neither mark.

The line does bend here, and in the direction the note says (the descent eases): centerline slope changes from dv/du -0.37 to -0.61. But two-line fits over several windows put the corner at u 1177.5 to 1180, v 2456 to 2458, best about (1178,2457). Q (1169,2459) is on the ink but on the straight part before the bend (the left segment fit stays straight to u 1170), about 9 px from the corner (8.7 to 11 px across fits), just over the 8 px limit. Low because the margin is about 1 px.

After the shallow trough at about (1264,2209), the trace has a small local maximum of deceleration (the centerline moves left to u 1261.0 over v 2152 to 2170; the left edge also reaches 1257 to 1258 there) before it drifts back to u 1265 by v 2100. Q (1261,2164) is on the ink at the height of that flat top. The bump is only about 3 px (about 0.3 g), so medium.

The trace comes in at a slant (center u 1301.5 at v 1780 to 1312 at v 1576, about 3 deg off vertical) and then runs vertical at center u about 1313 (v 1530 up to 1337), just right of the dashed line (dashes at u 1304 to 1308 there). A two-line fit of the trace's free edge puts the break at about (1313,1552); Q (1314,1559) is on the trace ink, not the dash, and about 7 px from it. Low because the turn is only about 3 deg, barely visible on a 4x crop, and the shallow angle makes the corner's position along v uncertain by about 10 px.

Q (1314,1315) is inside the top frame line (solid v 1311 to 1318, ragged edge at 1319). The trace (with the dashed line beside it, u 1303 to 1317) can be told from the frame only down to about v 1319 to 1320, so the sample is about 4 to 5 px past the last visible trace ink. Off.

All five P samples are on the trace ink, a continuous band at u 1325 to 1333 here, separate from the dashed line at u 1318 to 1323. (1328,2603): ink u 1325 to 1332. (1329,2610): ink u 1325 to 1333. (1330,2618): on the ruler line (v 2615 to 2619), but the trace ink runs through it on both sides. (1329,2626): ink u 1325 to 1333. (1330,2656): ink u 1327 to 1333.

All seven Q samples are on the trace ink (u about 2342 to 2353), separate from the dashed line (u 2333 to 2337). (2346,2586), (2346,2593), (2346,2601), (2347,2646) and (2349,2737) are on plain trace ink. (2346,2616) is on the ruler line and (2348,2707) on the timing line, but the trace runs through both on either side. None falls in the trace's break around the '0' label (v 2665 to 2701).

Q (2317,1305) is at the center of the top frame line (solid v 1301 to 1309, ragged edge at 1310). The trace (u 2313 to 2321) can be told from the frame only down to about v 1310, so the sample is about 5 px past the last visible trace ink. Off.
